sources.evidence: Maintainer history identifies IX_15beta, later CTD missing-value handling, partial-depth editing and magnetic-model updates, followed by a bottom-track fix for uplooker-only processing in the release. Master is mutable; this rendered review does not pin the precise executable used for either cast.
Current defaults identify release IX_15 and retain beta-version history. Current defaults are not proof of the parameters or code used for the retained beta casts.
Writer maps z, u, v and uerr to a common z dimension, writes dr fields and carries supplied units. This establishes writer structure only, not the sign convention or exact archived converter.

Solver assigns z and real/imaginary ocean components to dr.z/u/v. Its uerr computation is rescaled from residual component diagnostics. This is not an independent standard error, confidence interval or depth uncertainty.
ASCII writer exports dr.z/u/v/uerr. It does not establish the exact downstream NetCDF conversion path.

retained_header_evidence.interpretation: Both headers explicitly describe an ldeo_to_cdf conversion, similar but not identical to ladcp2cdf, with scalar geocodes and changed time/date representation. Do not equate the processor writer with the archive converter. Both retain downlooker and uplooker processing records; this does not certify correction of every beta issue. Warning records remain relevant and source final QC remains unverified.

closed_target_rule: No retries, mirror/raw-host bypass or alternate filename to obtain these failed resources. The earlier failed full cruise PDF remains closed. Previously reviewed IX14 manual is not new beta evidence.

excluded_literature_lead.reason: Primary article describes different yo-yo observations at an Izu-Ogasawara seamount in June 2023; it does not qualify the May 2022 western P02W casts or establish their Kuroshio-axis membership.

next_action: Keep both original casts retained with their original cumulative budgets. Pursue independent current-depth support while a compatible cohort and sufficient version/converter qualification are unavailable. Do not relax frozen IX14 guards or replace the failed third cast.
